say:1:1130524001:1.text: There are much fewer treasure hunters now. But some people, like the clients of these bounty hunters, still think it's real.
say:1:1130524001:1.source_cn: 寻宝人少了很多，但还是有，就像这几个赏金猎人，他们的委...
say:1:1130524001:1.male: There are much fewer treasure hunters now. But some people, like the clients of these bounty hunters, still think it's real.
say:1:1130524001:1.female: There are much fewer treasure hunters now. But some people, like the clients of these bounty hunters, still think it's real.

say:2:1130524002:1.text: I offer some friendly information and get called a liar in return.
say:2:1130524002:1.source_cn: 好心相劝，居然说俺骗人。
say:2:1130524002:1.male: I offer some friendly information and get called a liar in return.
say:2:1130524002:1.female: I offer some friendly information and get called a liar in return.

say:3:1130524003:1.text: Go on if you want, just don't cause any trouble.
say:3:1130524003:1.source_cn: 想去就去吧，只要别捣乱就行。
say:3:1130524003:1.male: Go on if you want, just don't cause any trouble.
say:3:1130524003:1.female: Go on if you want, just don't cause any trouble.
